description: Generate a JSON-LD <script> block for a schema.org type (LocalBusiness, Organization, WebSite, Article, FAQPage, or Product) from a flat data object. For FAQPage, pass data.items as [{ question, answer }].

data.description: Fields for the chosen type, e.g. { name, url, description, telephone }. FAQPage uses { items: [{ question, answer }] }.

name: generate_schema_markup

jsonLd.description: The JSON-LD <script type="application/ld+json"> block, ready to paste.

title: Generate schema markup
